sections.Profile:
"Aloha" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1961. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, two slingshots, two kick-out holes, and a gobble hole with an end-of-ball bonus.
